purpose: Freeze method identities and existing forward definitions; do not retrain neural models or overwrite previous results.

current_three_vessel.baseline: Conservative finite-volume advection and molecular diffusion; mean-product catalytic reaction; no flux-memory or learned correction
current_three_vessel.reaction: Th catalytic; Fg consumed and immobile Fn produced by the same reaction amount
current_three_vessel.junction: Perfectly mixed zero-volume junction with conservative branch fluxes
current_three_vessel.blood: Same selected Sen prediction and discrete conservation projection for all candidates
current_three_vessel.neural_policy: Keep all three frozen checkpoints; no seed selection on test results

published_single_vessel.baseline: Published conservative finite-volume solver with fixed five-parameter transport/reaction correction; no neural network
published_single_vessel.policy: Archive/reproduce the published comparison separately. Do not relabel C1 as C0 or transplant its coefficients to the three-vessel geometry.

evaluation_policy.frozen_historical_protocol: The completed three-vessel inverse tables are v1. Shared-regularization and model-specific-regularization results remain separate.
evaluation_policy.methods_unchanged_when: Changing observation windows, sensor layouts, objective scaling or inverse regularization requires reevaluation, not biochemical neural retraining.
evaluation_policy.next_inverse_protocol: After the fairness audit, any revised inverse weighting or regularization-selection rule must receive its own protocol/run identifier, use validation only and apply equally to every candidate. Preserve v1 results.
evaluation_policy.test_policy: Existing test cases have already been inspected; reruns are not a new blind test.
evaluation_policy.stronger_baseline: A calibrated non-neural three-vessel closure may be added only under a separate named method and version. It must not silently replace three-c0-fv-v1.
retraining_triggers: Changed neural architecture or closure equations
Changed training distribution, blood or geometry intended to be learned
A confirmed model implementation defect that invalidates the existing learned weights
